set.body: Cover sample_fixations, rep_fixations and random draws from density surfaces at the pinned eyesim revision. Separate deterministic point evaluation from random sampling; pin count and duration weighting, replacement, endpoint policy, requested versus realized cardinality and seeded RNG identity. Exit with exact small distributions, reproducible fixtures, explicit dropped or duplicated draws and a public eyes4s design/RNG route.
set.title: Specify reproducible fixation and density sampling
